books.title: Tibetan Yoga for Health & Well-Being: The Science and Practice of Healing Your Body, Energy, and Mind
books.author: Alejandro Chaoul
books.description: Ale Chaoul's Hay House guide to Tibetan yoga, built around the five principal breath-energies and the movements that work with each of the five chakras. He adds the history and lineage of the practice and keeps the instructions simple enough for daily life.

courses.title: Rekindling the Heart: Ancient Breath Practices, Tibetan Yoga & the Science of Emotion
courses.description: A three-day Esalen workshop that Ale co-leads with Eve Ekman, pairing research on emotion and resilience with the traditions behind it. Participants practise Tibetan yoga breathwork, mantra and heart-opening meditation and map the emotions that sit under stress.

left_out: Tibetan Yoga Wellbeing: Heart Practices, Life-Force & Longevity (Menla, 12-15 Nov 2026): starts before 16 Nov 2026, so out on the date rule; not reopened.
